definition: Net new units completed in the municipality's first Housing Target Order year, as a percentage of its Year 1 target. Net new units = completions (occupancy permits) minus demolitions.
source: BC Government news releases; Storeys housing targets tracker
source_detail: See data/housing_targets.csv for per-row source URLs
rag_rule: Green: 100% or more. Amber: 75% to 99.9%. Red: below 75%. Group 4: not yet assessed.
limitations: Year 1 periods differ by group, so results are not for the same 12 months. Some values from a secondary source (flagged). Municipal reports, not audited figures. Targets measure completions, which lag approvals by years.

definition: Average annual housing completions over the latest three years, per 1,000 households counted in the 2021 Census.
source: CMHC Starts and Completions Survey; Statistics Canada 2021 Census
source_detail: CMHC HMIP via cmhc R package; StatCan 98-10-0259-01
rag_rule: Green: at or above the BC rate. Amber: 75% to 99.9% of the BC rate. Red: below 75% of the BC rate.
limitations: Completions are gross (demolitions not subtracted), so they differ from Housing Supply Act net new units. The 2021 household denominator ages over time and understates current households in fast-growing places. CMHC's provincial total may not cover exactly the same areas as the household count.

definition: Percentage of private households in core housing need: living in housing that is unaffordable, inadequate (needs major repairs), or unsuitable (too few bedrooms), and unable to afford the median rent of acceptable alternative local housing.
rag_rule: Green: at or below the BC rate. Amber: up to 2 percentage points above. Red: more than 2 points above.
limitations: 2021 is the latest available year. Temporary pandemic income benefits in 2020 (the income year used by the 2021 Census) likely lowered measured need, so 2016 to 2021 changes should be read with caution. Excludes households on reserve, in farm dwellings, with zero or negative income, and some student-led households.

indicator_name: Renter households in core housing need
definition: As above, for renter households only.
rag_rule: Green: at or below the BC rate. Amber: up to 2 percentage points above. Red: more than 2 points above.
limitations: As for CHN_ALL. Small renter populations give less stable rates; suppressed cells shown as missing.

indicator_name: Renter households spending 30%+ of income on shelter
definition: Percentage of renter households whose shelter-cost-to-income ratio is 30% or more. Shelter costs include rent and utilities.
rag_rule: Green: at or below the BC rate. Amber: up to 2 percentage points above. Red: more than 2 points above.
limitations: Uses before-tax income. Some households (e.g. students, people with temporarily low incomes) exceed 30% without being in housing need, which is why core housing need is the preferred headline measure.

direction: Higher is better (up to a point)
definition: Percentage of purpose-built rental units (buildings with 3 or more rental units) that are vacant and available for rent in October.
source_detail: CMHC HMIP via cmhc R package
comparator: 3% (industry rule of thumb for a balanced market)
rag_rule: Green: 3.0% or above. Amber: 2.0% to 2.9%. Red: below 2.0%.
limitations: Covers purpose-built rentals only, not rented condos or secondary suites. CMHC's 2026 mid-year rental market update notes the balanced vacancy rate varies by market, so 3% is a reference point, not a target. Small rental universes give unstable rates; suppressed years are missing.

definition: Year-over-year percentage change in average rent for units in the CMHC sample in both years (same-sample), so new buildings do not distort the change.
source_detail: CMHC HMIP via cmhc R package
limitations: Frequently suppressed for smaller municipalities; latest year shown and flagged when out of date.

definition: Average monthly rent for purpose-built rental units, all bedroom types.
source_detail: CMHC HMIP via cmhc R package
limitations: Average across all units including long-term tenancies, so it is below current asking rents. Mix of unit sizes affects comparisons between municipalities.

definition: Number of new dwelling units completed in the calendar year, all dwelling types.
source_detail: CMHC HMIP via cmhc R package
